sla.title: How orders work — time limits & rules
sla.t1b: Accept within 3 minutes. If not, it is cancelled automatically, the customer is refunded and it counts on your shop’s record.
sla.t2b: The pharmacist reviews it within 15 minutes. If not, the order is cancelled and counts on your record.
sla.t3b: Mark it Ready by the time you promised. 10 minutes late — you get a reminder. 30 minutes late — Delivez ops call you. Running behind? Use Delay so the customer and rider see the new time.
sla.t4b: Give the order to the rider only after checking the handover code or scanning the QR.
sla.endH: If an order ends early — who pays
sla.e1: You reject it, miss a time limit, or can’t make it
sla.e1b: Customer gets a full refund. No payment to you. It counts on your shop’s record.
sla.e2: Delivez, the rider or bad weather stops it
sla.e2b: Customer gets a full refund. If you had already started cooking, Delivez pays you for the food.
sla.e3b: Only possible before you accept — nothing lost. After you accept, only Delivez support can cancel; if food was being made, Delivez pays you for it.
sla.e4: Delivery fails at the customer’s door
sla.e4b: Food: Delivez pays you for it. Groceries and medicines: the rider brings them back — check them in as “back on shelf” or “damaged” on the order.
sla.retB: The rider waits 5 minutes while the customer checks. Damaged, wrong or expired items come back to you and are taken off the bill — so pack carefully and check dates.
sla.tip1: Too busy? Set your shop to Busy (or Closed) on the dashboard instead of rejecting orders.
sla.tip2: An item ran out? Mark that item unavailable or offer a substitute — don’t reject the whole order.
sla.tip3: Every ended order shows “Why this order ended” on its page, with any amount Delivez pays you.

lc.groc.pBody: Kiranas, supermarkets, and fruit and vegetable shops take orders here. Registration is free, and Delivez riders deliver.
lc.vp.fqOne: Can I add items from different shops to one order?
lc.vp.faOne: No. Each order comes from one shop, so it all arrives together. For another shop, place a separate order.
lc.rush.lede: Groceries, medicines, snacks and household needs from the shops that can reach you fastest, brought by a Delivez rider.
lc.rush.noneOpen: No essentials shop near you is open right now.
lc.rush.needIntro: Items from essentials shops open near you, quickest delivery first.
lc.rush.packIntro: Everyday needs put together from one shop near you. Add the whole pack in one tap.
lc.rush.soonBody: Small Delivez stores stocked only with everyday essentials, close to where you live, so orders can leave in minutes. Until they open, Rush brings you essentials from the quickest shops already on Delivez.
lc.rush.pBody: Grocery shops, pharmacies, bakeries and household stores take orders here. Registration is free, and Delivez riders deliver.
lc.rush.fa1: Rush lists the shops that can reach you quickest. Each one shows its delivery time before you order. It depends on the shop and how far it is from you.
lc.rush.fa2: Delivez Rush stores will be small stores stocked only with essentials. They are not open yet. Until then, Rush shows essentials from shops already on Delivez.
lc.rush.fa3: Yes, from pharmacies near you. Medicines that need a prescription aren’t listed on Rush. Order them from the pharmacy’s page, where you can upload your prescription.
lc.rush.lateTitle: Up late? These are still open.
lc.rush.howTitle: How a Rush order reaches you.
lc.rush.howIntro: From the quickest shop near you to your door. Watch an order go through every step.
lc.rush.howEta: Right now {store} can reach you in {time}.
lc.rush.zIntro: See which essentials shops deliver to a place, and how fast. Pick your location or a city, or type an area or pincode.
lc.rush.zPinNo: Delivez doesn’t deliver to pincode {pin} yet.
lc.rush.zPinLogin: Log in to see the Rush shops there.
lc.rush.zLogin: Log in to look up a place by name, or enter a 6-digit pincode.
lc.rush.zNotFound: We couldn’t find “{q}”. Try another area name or a pincode.
lc.rush.zClosed: Rush shops that deliver to {place} are closed right now.
lc.rush.zNone: No Rush shops deliver to {place} yet.
lc.rush.zCaption: Pins show each shop at its real distance and direction. Tap one for its delivery time.
lc.street.lede: Chaat, chai, fruit, milk and more from street vendors and society vendors near you, brought by a Delivez rider.
lc.street.qPh: Search a vendor or what they sell
lc.street.listIntro: Street carts and society vendors that deliver to you, nearest first.
lc.street.noneBody: Street and society vendors are joining Delivez. Check back soon, or order from other shops nearby.
lc.street.itemsIntro: From vendors open now. Add them straight to your cart.
lc.street.j1b: Register on Delivez Partners with your mobile number and an OTP.
lc.street.j2b: Your name, what you sell, where you stand and your hours. Add a landmark photo, FSSAI or trade licence if you have them.
lc.street.j3b: Add items and prices from your phone, and switch them off when they run out.
lc.street.j4b: Accept orders in the app. A Delivez rider picks up and delivers, with 0% commission during the launch offer.
lc.street.pTitle: Sell from your cart on Delivez.
lc.street.pBody: Street carts, stalls and society vendors take orders here. Registration is free, and Delivez riders deliver.
lc.street.fa1: Street carts, stalls and vendors who serve housing societies, registered on Delivez like any other shop. Each one shows its distance, timings and rating.
lc.street.fa2: A flat {fee} per order, with no platform or packaging fee. You see the full bill before you pay.
lc.street.fq3: Can I pick up from the cart myself?
lc.street.fa3: Not yet. Orders from vendors are delivered by a Delivez rider.
lc.street.mapTitle: Who is near you right now.
lc.street.mapIntro: Every vendor that delivers to you, at its real distance and direction from your address. Tap one to see what it sells.
lc.street.mapNote: Pins show where each vendor is registered on Delivez, not a live location.
lc.street.toolsTitle: Hand over with a code. Ask for it your way.
lc.street.toolsIntro: Every order is handed over with a code, and you can tell the shop how you want it.
lc.street.codeWhere: Your code shows on the order page once you’ve ordered.
lc.street.codePickup: Collecting from the cart yourself isn’t available yet. Every order comes with a Delivez rider.
lc.street.askBody: Less spicy, extra ripe, cut and packed? Write a note and it goes to the shop with your order.
lc.street.askGo: Go to checkout with this note
lc.street.askEmpty: Add something to your cart first.
lc.street.impTitle: Every order goes to a local vendor.
lc.street.impIntro: Carts and stalls sell on Delivez with just a phone. Registration is free, and Delivez riders deliver.
